cases.answer_excerpt:
If BCIT grants you transfer credit for a course in a full-time program, your tuition generally does not decrease, though your course load will be lighter. To submit official transcripts for a transfer credit application, they must be sent directly to BCIT from the institution you previously attended or dropped off in a sealed, stamped envelope; scanned copies are not accepted.

* **Transcript Submission Requirements:** 
  * Official transcripts must be sent directly from your prior post-secondary institution(s) to BCIT, or dropped off in person in an original sealed and stamped envelope.

cases.question: money back if i withdraw after classes start?
cases.standalone_question: Can I get a refund or money back if I withdraw from a course or program after classes start at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You may be eligible for a tuition refund if you withdraw after classes start, provided you do so by the specific program or course refund deadline. 

* **Full-time programs:** For most full-time programs, your latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a refund is 10 business days after the start of class. Commitment fees are non-refundable (for example, $500 for domestic technology and degree programs), and this amount is deducted from your refund.
* **Flexible Learning (Part-time Studies) courses:** Refund eligibility depends on the course length and format. For classroom, blended, or synchronous courses longer than four weeks, the deadline for an 85% tuition refund is prior to the second class. For asynchronous distance/online courses longer than four weeks, the deadline is within two weeks of the course start date for an 85% refund. Continual entry courses lasting more than two weeks offer a 100% refund if you withdraw within two weeks of registration or the course start date.
* **Apprenticeship programs:** Refunds depend on how far in advance you cancel prior to the class start date. No refunds are issued for withdrawals less than nine days before the start of class, or after the third day of class.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/refunds-withdrawals/

**Details:**
- **Commitment Fee Refundability:** Once paid to confirm acceptance into a full-time program, the commitment fee is non-refundable and non-transferable. - **Domestic Technology Student Deductions:** If you withdraw from a full-time technology program and are eligible for a refund, a $500 commitment fee is deducted for domestic students (international students have $6,000 deducted).
- **Withdrawal Deadline:** For most full-time programs, the latest acceptable withdrawal date to receive a tuition refund is 10 business days after the start of class.
